findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/IntegralLattices/README.md Layer 1: "Construct form scaling, form negation, and orthogonal direct sums. State exactly how rank, determinant, discriminant, integrality, evenness, nondegeneracy, the radical, and the signature behave: … negation exchanges `n₊` and `n₋` and fixes `n₀`". Head checkout: Isometry.lean:69 `structure Isometry`, Signature.lean:31 `signature`, Even.lean `IsEven`, OrthogonalSum.lean:82 `orthogonalSum` — none in the diff.
findings.fix: Either add the signature/evenness/radical laws for `n • L` and `-L` (at minimum `signature_neg` exchanging n₊/n₋ and fixing n₀, and evenness transport) using the merged `Signature.lean`/`Even.lean`, or correct the description to state the true remaining work and why these laws are a separate unit.
findings.issue: The description defers the evenness, isometry, signature and radical behaviour of scaling/negation as awaiting "in-flight" APIs, and says the milestone "still needs orthogonal direct sums". All four are already on main at this head: TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry.lean, Signature.lean, Even.lean and OrthogonalSum.lean exist and are absent from the diff. The roadmap bullet requires exactly what is skipped for negation — "negation exchanges n₊ and n₋ and fixes n₀" — and its dependency is merged.

summary: Scaling and negation are an explicitly named Layer 1 deliverable of the IntegralLattices roadmap, undated by no existing API, and the PR is a single coherent unit. But the description misstates the repo state to justify deferring the roadmap's evenness/signature/radical behaviour for the new operations, which is stateable on current main.
